articleTitle: Scenario based Deep Learning Prediction for Legal Judgment using LSTM and CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: The problem facing society is the dark side of law ignorance. This paper is planned to build the solution to solve the problem of people’s ignorance in the law department. This paper provides deep analyses of problem scenarios or crime scenes and provides technical suggestions for people irrespective of branch. It guides the people to take the necessary steps to make them aware of the case section and the evidence to be needed. This helps to glow the light of justice for illiterate people. It gives the work of architecture of law with chains of the future. This function gives the superpower of critical analysis and support assistance of legal terms. The lawyer’s more critical work and legal terms are not aware by the people, this gives ultimate protection to survive and grip the handle of justice. This shows the real power of justice and the work of architecture of law. This is the best system people wish for the assistance of law and the judiciary. This shows the percentage of success in terms of law and evidence required. This gives real-time assistance based on the understanding of the scenario of the case and the type of case for which it is required. The NLP is used for the preprocessing steps to get the feature of the documents and also helps in linear vectorizing. This works on the methodology of vectorization using BERT with the dataset of cases. The vectorized input is trained into the LSTM and CNN for model generation. The generated model is accumulated for the best results for each scenario and propagates to find the network and form the connections.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Automatic Vehicle Number Plate Recognition for Vehicle Authentication and Intelligent Security System
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Vehicle number plate recognition is useful in tollway, parking area, highways, traffic signals, etc. In all these places vehicle number needs to be registered either manually or systematically for future reference. By registering the vehicle number, officials can easily trace the vehicle owner’s details from the database. So we can identify the cause for the problems like robbery, kidnap, and illegal activities. In the proposed work, vehicle number plate recognition has been automatically collected and maintain the database of the vehicle number with the help of deep learning algorithm. The system proceeds with the following steps. Firstly, vehicles need to be identified from CCTV. For this process, a coherent model namely Faster R-CNN is used. Secondly, number plates from the identified vehicles need to be separated to recognize the numbers. Finally, OCR is used in the extracted image to spot the numeric and alphabets in the number plate. The accuracy of 98% achieved in this system.

articleTitle: HelmetGuard: IoT-Enabled Smart Helmet for Enhanced Safety
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: The "HelmetGuard" program is a groundbreaking development in the realm of safety gear since it integrates Internet of Things (IoT) technology into conventional helmets. This method aims to modernize the traditional helmet and provide a safer, smarter, and more interactive headgear. The HelmetGuard collects real-time information on the user’s surroundings and vital signs via integrated sensors, wireless communication modules, and a central processing unit. This information is then processed and evaluated to deliver immediate feedback, allowing preventative safety steps. The helmet has functions including sleep detection, GPS tracking, alcohol detection, ignition control, and required mandatory presence of helmet. It also has features like ignition control and accident detection. The HelmetGuard seeks to greatly improve user safety and make the world a safer place by seamlessly integrating IoT capabilities with safety equipment.

articleTitle: A Systematic Approach in Detecting Brain Tumor using CCNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: A brain tumor (BT) is characterized by the presence of abnormal cell growth, whether these cells are malignant or not. In BT conditions, the number of these cells increases and multiplies rapidly, causing uncontrolled growth. Detecting brain tumors at an early stage is crucial for timely prognosis and diagnosis. Recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) have made it possible to forecast the growth of brain tumors more quickly. Deep learning and ML algorithms play a vital role in achieving higher accuracy, which greatly benefits patient treatment. This study aimed to develop a framework for a Competence Convolutional Neural Network (CCNN) model and establish parameters for training the model and predicting its accuracy, referred to as predictive diagnosis (PD). The research utilized a dataset of 150 brain tumor diagnoses, based on MRI images, to assess the proposed methodology using a ML-based CNN. The algorithm demonstrated an exceptional accuracy rate of 93% in the training phase, 87.34% in validation, and 89.5% during testing. These results surpass the accuracy of traditional methods for brain cancer detection in comparative studies.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an IoT Enabled Multi Features Smart Bag and Women’s Security Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: IoT-Based Smart Bag and Women Security System is an novel solution to address the raising problem of women’s safety and offers protection to their personal belongings while providing real-time status updates. In recent days, women often face insecure situations in society. To overcome this, a safety-oriented method has been proposed. When the person is attacked by any of the strangers of thieves, the person can use the push button by which an alert notification is delivered to the registered smart phone number with the person’s location. Additionally, the bag is provided with a shock generator that can be used by women to defend themselves against attacks from strangers or theft people, which generates an electric shock of 550V. The bag is also assisted with a finger print detector is used for securing the zipper to avoid theft. An internal lighting system have been used which detects the intensity of light and automatically switches ON when the intensity is low for ease of locating items and a wireless charger for consumer’s convenience. This system utilizes components such as ESP32, a fingerprint sensor, and a GPS system helps tracing the exact location of the bag. The collected data can visualize through the Adafruit dashboard, that offers users a clear view of the bag’s location, and ON and OFF status of LED and fingerprint sensor.

articleTitle: IOT based Dialysis Process Control and Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: In hemodialysis machine, peristaltic pump is responsible for transporting fluids. The pump is attached with stepper motor, gear box and rotor shaft with two rollers during the process of dialysis. The volume of fluid flowing through the pump depends on the tube segments pressed by the roller. In this case, there occurs a deviation in the amount of transported fluid. The aim of this paper is to design an embedded microcontroller system for monitoring and controlling the blood pumping speed in dialysis machine and to provide an instant biometric feedback through Internet of Things. The Arduino microcontroller is the main controller element incorporated with suitable sensors for transporting the controlled fluid volume in this system. IOT is the key element of the project. Four sensors are used for collecting patient biometric feedback and the output from these sensors is continuously stored in an external server. The doctor can evaluate the conditions of the patient by opening this server and monitor them irrespective of time or place. By implementing this system, the deviation in the amount of delivered fluid can be controlled and at the same time cost effective treatment is performed through IOT.

articleTitle: Investigations on Swarm Optimization Algorithms for Classification of EEG Signals in Detection of Epilepsy
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Epilepsy is a mental illness that affects many people around the world. In the clinical setting, an electroencephalogram (EEG) is the gold standard for brain imaging. Mental retardation, epilepsy, coma, schizophrenia and sleep disorders are just a few of the many conditions that EEG is used to diagnose and treat. Early and accurate diagnosis of epilepsy is difficult due to many limitations, some of which are unrepresentative, lack of flexibility, scalability issues, and individual variations. This limitation can be overcome by using advanced machine learning techniques with appropriate removal techniques or data reduction techniques and analysis of larger datasets. By using population optimization techniques such as feature extraction, feature selection, and classification, the best results for classification of EEG signals were achieved. Because its purpose is to increase the accuracy of the diagnosis of epilepsy EEG signals. In this work, the PSO with XX outperformed with the accuracy of 95%, MCC of xx% for xx classifiers.

articleTitle: A Holistic Approach to Food Waste Management: Leveraging Full-Stack Technologies for Efficient Resource Utilization
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Food waste is a major global problem that has a negative impact on the environment and the economy. Using full-stack technology, including data gathering, analytics, and decision-making procedures, this article proposes a comprehensive food waste management system. This system utilizes cutting-edge techniques to reduce food waste and maximize resource use throughout its entire lifecycle. The food waste management system provides useful data-driven analysis for waste reduction methods by utilizing this technological stack. Users can create reports and visualizations that help them spot inefficiencies, set goals for reducing waste, and track their advancement over time. Thanks to this data-driven approach, stakeholders may implement focused interventions, make well-informed decisions, and maximize resource use. The comprehensive food waste management system presented in this article was created utilizing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, PHP, and Bootstrap technologies. A user-friendly interface, real-time updates, and sophisticated data analysis capabilities are made possible by the integration of these tools. The solution gives stakeholders access to useful information about their patterns of food waste so they can put those insights into practice and develop efficient waste reduction measures.

articleTitle: Hand Written Digit Recognition using Multilayer Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: In machine learning, handwritten digit recognition is usually seen as a multi-class classification problems In this approach, the ten possible digits (0-9) are treated as individual classes, and the goal is to train a classifier that can accurately identify them. However, it’s not unusual for a single classifier to have varying levels of success when applied to different datasets, even after being trained using a standard learning algorithm. This indicates that while a given learning algorithm may be effective at training strong classifiers on certain datasets, it may result in weaker classifiers for others. Furthermore, it’s possible for a classifier to exhibit varying levels of performance on multiple test datasets, especially considering that different writers may produce highly diverse image samples of the same numbers. To address this issue, the advancement of ensemble learning methodologies will be critical, as they have the potential to improve overall prediction accuracy and offer more consistent performance across different datasets.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning Regression Model to Predict the Optimum Election Algorithm for Parallel and Distributed Computing Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Parallel and distributed computing has become a necessity when it comes to high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, big data analytics, machine learning, deep learning, signal processing and bioengineering. System engineers connect distributed systems, with large number of nodes, that then compute the solution for a problem concurrently. The distributed system has a leader that manages the overall coordination of these connected nodes. This research provides a novel approach to predict the most efficient and time-feasible election algorithm, that must be ran on a distributed system, using linear regression machine learning approach. This research implements the prediction process for three election algorithms and successfully predicts the most efficient and least time-consuming algorithm with 94.98% accuracy. Initially, the dataset for the regression model training was created by executing the three election algorithms parallelly using MPI running 16 parallel processors (cores). The research also presents three regression line equations, trained and modelled on this dataset, that can be used to predict the execution time for the three algorithms for a system with any number of nodes. The results are duly visualized, and regression lines are plotted for comparison.

articleTitle: Voice Stimulated Inclusive Multiplayer Game Development with Speaker Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Gaming technologies have now become an inseparable part of audio processing applications. Several innovations have been made to improve gaming experience. Now the user does not necessarily need a joystick to interact with the computer, his gestures and vocal stimuli can act as controllers. This study provides a novel solution towards developing inclusive games for all with the use of natural language processing and human computer interaction. We discuss the development of a multiplayer game that uses speaker recognition to differentiate between multiple player’s vocal stimuli, thus allowing players to play voice-controlled games on the same device in proximity.

articleTitle: Prediction of Happiness Score by Adopting Simple Linear Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Happiness is a topic that experts are studying more and more in today’s culture. Investigating pleasure from the standpoint of data mining is intriguing. The use of mining data, which operates from a fresh knowledge-driven perspective, is steadily becoming more ubiquitous and well-liked in the psychology field. Research on machine learning in particular, which is now being studied, brings fresh concepts and novel approaches to research to the field of psychiatry. This study examines the accuracy of learning-based happiness prediction methods using linear regression. We discuss the happiness variables that influence it and present the experimental findings of happiness prediction. This study examines the factors influencing happiness and examine the effects of various ensembles for pleasure prediction using the four stages of factor analysis, feature engineering, model establishment, and evaluation. According to the findings of the investigation, certain individual factors—such as mental health, socioeconomic level, and social rank—have a stronger impact on happiness than others. These factors include societal attitudes, income of the person and family capital. Furthermore, boosting performs the best in modelling fusion among the happiness prediction models created by these five characteristics.

articleTitle: A Design Thinking Approach of Metaheuristic Empowerment for Energy-Efficient and Optimized Routing protocol in IoT-Enabled Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: This research focuses on energy-efficient routing in WSNs within IoT contexts, comparing established protocols like SEP, HEED, TEEN with the proposed SEP-ACO protocol. By strategically selecting cluster heads based on residual energy, these protocols optimize energy usage, enhancing data collection and transmission. Experimental evaluations highlight SEP-ACO's superior performance, showcasing improved packet delivery ratios and reduced energy consumption compared to existing approaches. This work emphasizes the significance of energy-efficient routing for extending WSNs' operational lifetime in emerging IoT-enabled environments, contributing to IoT and sensor technology advancements.

articleTitle: Analysis of 6T Static Random Access Memory Using CMOS Technology with 22nm Standard
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Random-access memory that uses latching circuitry is a crucial part of the cohesive cache memory of portable digital devices. In order to analyze a 6T SRAM using CMOS technology, it is necessary to look at the SRAM cell structure, operation, and performance metrics. The six transistors that make up an SRAM cell each have a specific function that they do. High speed, limited space occupancy, and efficient power consumption are all made possible by the CMOS technology utilized in the construction of the SRAM cell. Several criteria, including read and write access times, power consumption, and stability, are taken into consideration while analyzing the 6T SRAM cell’s performance. Process variation, temperature changes, and voltage fluctuations are other variables that have an impact on the cell’s performance. As a result, simulations of various operating situations are used in the analysis of the cell to gain a complete understanding of its behavior. The 6T SRAM was examined using CMOS technology, and the results show that the cell has a high level of stability, quick read and write computing times, and low power usage. However, process variance, changes in temperature, and voltage fluctuations can all have an impact on the cell’s performance. Overall, SRAM consisting of six transistors cell with CMOS structure is a productive memory cell that can be employed in a variety of settings, such as image processing, digital signal processing, and microprocessors. The construction and execution of a 6T SRAM cell using industry-standard Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) processes at 45nm and 22nm are described in this work. LTSpice XVII has been used to run the simulation.

articleTitle: A Survey on Segmentation Techniques in Fractal Classification Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Fractal-based classification systems have gained significant attention in recent years due to their ability to model complex data structures efficiently. These systems rely on the segmentation of data into self-replicating patterns, which are integral to their classification process. This survey explores the various segmentation techniques such as image pyramids, wavelet transform, region growing, k-means clustering, and fractal dimension-based segmentation employed in fractal classification systems, providing an in-depth analysis of their strengths, weaknesses, and applications. Each technique is evaluated based on its suitability for different data types and domains, highlighting their advantages and limitations. Finally, the survey outlines the current challenges and future directions in the field of fractal-based classification systems, emphasizing the need for improved segmentation techniques to handle large and complex datasets. By providing a comprehensive overview of segmentation methods in the context of fractal classification, this survey aims to contribute insights for improved pattern recognition in diverse applications.

articleTitle: Octobot for Child Rescue from Open Bore Well
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Accidents at bore wells are now frequent worldwide. Some of the kids are rescued, but most of the time, we lose to save their lives. The main goal of this project is to develop and build an octobot for saving a child from an open borewell. There are several methods available to rescue the child. However, using just one strategy might not be feasible. But, these methods/techniques are time-consuming and may not be successful in most cases. To address the problem, we proposed an octobot capable of taking out the child from the bore well methodically. The proposed system comprises a camera, lighting, oxygen source, and balloon technology. Sensors and the camera monitor the child’s depth, position, and state. The child is kept from slipping back into deep with its assistance. And the child is raised on a balloon-filled pillow. The octobot is controlled manually by a human, who also uses a computer or a mobile application to monitor it. According to ongoing assessments, the child is being saved securely, and the necessary medical arrangements may be made to save the child’s life.

articleTitle: Significance of LASSO Regression as Feature Extraction Techniques in Diabetic Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Diabetes Mellitus (DM) is a global health concern, with early and accurate identification playing a crucial role in personalized treatment. In this study, we utilize Lasso regression-based feature extraction to reduce high-dimensional gene data (2870x10) to a more manageable (51x1) per patient. Different classifiers techniques include, Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), Softmax Discriminant Classifier (SDC), and Support Vector Machine (SVM) with different kernel’s as linear, polynomial, and radial basis function (RBF) kernels, evaluate by using different performance metrics such as Acc, F1 score, MCC as Matthews Correlation Coefficient, ER as Error Rate, and the FM metric as Fowlkes-Mallows. Results show that the SVM-RBF Kernal classifier attains an accuracy of 92.86% and a low error rate of 7.14%, demonstrating the potential of our approach in accurately distinguishing the Non-Diabetic Patients (NDP) and Diabetic Patients (DP) individuals from source of microarray gene data.

articleTitle: System On-Chip (SoC) Design of Signal Processing Unit for Wearable Cardioverter Defibrillator
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: In today’s modern lifestyle, stress has become a major part. Due to changing lifestyle and food habits, cardiac problems have become a major threat to human life. Cardiac arrest, arrhythmias and dysrhythmias are some of the common medical complications witnessed in humans. They are the medical complexities, wherein the heart beats at an abnormal rate. Defibrillators play a major role in treating cardiac problems. It is intended to treat arrhythmias and dysrhythmias. One of the recent advancements in the field of wearable defibrillators is the wearable cardioverter defibrillator (WCD). The project aims at developing an SoC for signal processing of this wearable defibrillator application. Instead of having individual modules, integrating them to a single one will reduce the size of the defibrillator, thereby reducing the cost and weight too.

articleTitle: Cancer Classification Revolution: Employing Advanced Deep CNNs for Multi-Class Detection of Breast Irregularities
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: early detection plays a pivotal role in reducing breast cancer mortality rates significantly. Detecting breast cancer at an early stage can increase positive outcomes by up to 8%. While radiologists analyze breast images using techniques such as mammograms, X-rays, and MRIs, accurately identifying features like micro calcifications, lumps, and masses remains challenging, leading to high false positives and false negatives. Recent advancements in deep learning and image processing offer hope for more advanced tools in early breast cancer diagnosis. This study focuses on constructing a Deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) capable of recognizing and categorizing various breast abnormalities, including lumps, asymmetries, calcifications, and carcinomas. Unlike previous research that primarily differentiated between benign and malignant cancers, this approach allows for more specialized disease treatment. The methodology involves transfer learning using a pre-trained model (ResNet50), fine-tuning it with the available dataset, and developing an enhanced deep learning model emphasizing learning speed. The proposed deep learning model achieved an impressive 88% accuracy in classifying masses, calcifications, carcinomas, and asymmetrical mammograms. This progress holds significant promise for improving the overall accuracy of breast cancer diagnosis and subsequent treatment decisions. The study aligns with ongoing efforts to enhance early detection and treatment, potentially saving lives through more efficient medical procedures.

articleTitle: Non-Invasive Blood Parameters Detection for Healthcare Applications using IOT
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: The conventional technique involves taking human blood samples in an intrusive way in order to measure the salt level, hemoglobin, and glucose rate. These methods may be painful and put the patient at risk for infection. These procedures may cause fear in the children. In order to address this issue, we suggest a non-invasive method that combines ISEs, PPG, and infrared (IR) sensors to measure salt, glucose, and hemoglobin levels. By studying the absorption and reflection of infrared light by blood vessels in the subcutaneous tissue, the IR sensor will be used to detect the amount of glucose in the body. PPG operates by measuring the pulsatile blood flow through the arteries, which will reveal information about hemoglobin levels. Lastly, an ISEs sensor will be used to measure sweat pH, which is correlated with sodium concentration, in order to monitor salt levels. Advanced machine learning techniques will be used to interpret the data from these sensors and deliver precise, real-time measures of sodium, hemoglobin, and glucose. To further assess the patient’s breathing condition, we have added a breathe analyzer. The IR sensor yields the breathing analyzer output. By using a thermometer, we may analyze the patient’s breaths per minute using a graphical waveform, with the breaths taken in a minute being represented by the peak value.

articleTitle: Design of Efficient Quantum-Dot Cellular Automata Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: QCA, the appealing nature of this thrilling new technology makes it a compelling alternative to CMOS technology as it enables the design of digital circuitry that is highly dense, power-efficient, and capable of exceptional performance. It’s based on polarisation of cell and the transfer of information to adjacent cells is accomplished using Coulomb interaction. Nevertheless, there are a number of difficulties in designing digital circuits for QCA, and it would be ideal to use innovative implementation techniques. This project suggests a novel design strategy focused on the development and application of a serial parallel repeater in a QCA. By utilising the systolic method, the proposed Multiplier provides an improved area. The Multiplier suggested here has considerably higher speed and a smaller overall footprint than its existing counterparts.

articleTitle: Sign Language to Regional Language Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: In recent days most people who are disabled are not able to make proper communication with others. Deaf people frequently communicate through sign language, a kind of manual communication. There are many different sign languages used by deaf people around the world; sign language is not a global language. Recognizing activities from sign languages is a computer job known as sign language recognition, or SLR for short. The main motive of the project is to translate their sign language to regional language through which we can able to full fil their needs. By providing input data through the form of speech, text, or sign language in the translation process, it is possible to change the translation for them better.

articleTitle: Smart Bitcoin Alert System
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Bitcoin, a decentralized digital currency, operates without the involvement of traditional financial institutions. Bitcoin transactions are conducted directly between parties, without the use of intermediaries, thanks to blockchain technology. Wallets, public keys, and private keys are necessary for the secure transactions of this cryptocurrency. Transaction can take place using Bitcoin simply going via centralized exchanges, in contrast with numerous other cryptocurrencies. This paper explores the unique features of Bitcoin and its advantages over other crypto assets. Notably, the decentralized and distributed ledger of blockchain technology ensures the secure storage of verified bitcoin transactions by network nodes. This distinguishes Bitcoin from assets that rely on centralized exchanges for verification. Recognizing the growing acceptance of Bitcoin in various transactions, including those conducted by small businesses, this research focuses on the need for accurate early prediction of Bitcoin prices. The study proposes leveraging machine learning algorithms, specifically Random Forest and Deep Learning (Long Short Term Memory), to predict the open and close values of Bitcoin. This predictive analysis aims to assist investors in making informed decisions and optimizing their Bitcoin investments. Accurate early forecast of Bitcoin prices is a need, as this research highlights, given the increasing use of Bitcoin in a variety of activities, including small company transactions. In order to forecast the open and closing prices of Bitcoin, the study suggests using machine learning techniques, notably Random Forest and Deep Learning (Long Short Term Memory). By using predictive analysis, investors may maximize their Bitcoin investments and make well-informed judgements. The study emphasizes the importance of accurate price predictions for Bitcoin investors and introduces machine learning algorithms as effective tools for achieving this goal. A comparative analysis of Random Forest and Long Short Term Memory algorithms will be conducted to evaluate their accuracy in predicting Bitcoin prices. The research aims to provide investors with valuable insights into optimizing their investment strategies based on reliable early predictions of Bitcoin values. This idea is reliable using Machine Learning which provides effective results. By Comparing the accuracy between two algorithms the prediction of bitcoin will be implemented. This can be done using Machine Learning Algorithm (Random Forest) and Deep Learning Algorithm (Long Short Term Memory). This prediction will help the bitcoin investors to identify the open and close value of the bitcoin so that the investors can invest their bitcoin in an efficient manner and get benefited.

articleTitle: Channel Estimation of XL-MIMO in 6G Communication System - Near Field Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: The demand on high data rate requirements will be addressed in a future 6G communication systems. In the 6G communication, extremely larger volumes of array antennas (XL MIMO) are used at transmitters (base stations) and receivers (User equipment). The XL-MIMO is an important technology in 6G communication and it produces certain fundamental changes in the nature of electric and magnetic field property. The characteristics of the field can be analyzed in the region of near-field and far-field components. The separation line among two fields can be defined by rayleigh distance and Advanced Rayleigh Distance (ARD). The behavior of the channel estimated in the near-field can be analyzed using NMSE (Normalized Mean Square Error). In this paper, the Rayleigh distance and Advanced Rayleigh distance are calculated for 28GHz, 50GHz and 60GHz frequencies and NMSE is plotted in the near field regions with direct line of sight and non direct line of sight path component parameters from the distance 50 to 500 meters.

articleTitle: Sign Language Interpreter via Gesture Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Our primary aim is to create an application that takes input from the user in the form of a photo or video, interprets and translates the sign language symbols represented in the given input and outputs the given translation in the form of text or speech. We analyze existing solutions for the communication barrier between Human Information Interactions (HII’s) and other people such as text-to-speech algorithms and aim to improve on them by providing better ease of use and accuracy. We utilize the LSTM Model for the processing and prediction of the input video frames, resulting in an output containing the descriptive textual caption of the sign-language performed.

articleTitle: Classification of Breast Cancer: A Comparative Study using K-Means Clustering-Based Feature Extraction and Hybrid Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: In order to save a person’s life, it is essential to diagnose and identify cancer as early as possible. Breast cancer is one of the deadliest diseases women may have, and it’s a major focus of medical research. Breast cancer starts in the cells and tissues of the breast. A breast lump, along with other symptoms including an abrupt shift in breast size or shape, leaking fluid from the nipple, and a generally moist feeling to the skin, are all telltale markers of breast cancer. As the disease progresses, symptoms such as shortness of breath, bone discomfort, and swollen lymph nodes may become apparent. Breast cancer is the second biggest cause of death among women worldwide. It’s one of the most common forms of cancer among females. Since the root cause of the condition is unknown, early discovery, classification, and diagnosis are essential. If breast cancer is detected early, it is highly curable. In this work the breast cancer risk of patients is classified using a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), and the hybrid classifiers Firefly GMM, Cuckoo Search GMM, Harmonic Search GMM and PSO GMM the results are presented in terms of classification accuracy, error rate, sensitivity, specificity and Jaccard Metric. Among these five classifiers the hybrid classifier PSO GMM attained maximum accuracy of 94% with minimum error rate of 6%.

articleTitle: Pancreatic Cancer Diagnosis using Swarm Optimization Combined with Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: When compared to different types of malignant tumors, pancreatic malignancy is the 12<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> widespread tumor disease among humans globally. Pancreatic cancer can be identified at the earlier stages using microarray gene analysis. The objective of this work is to classify the gene samples as normal and tumoral through the usage of Particle Swarm Optimization technique along with the supervised machine learning classifiers. A variance-based feature selection is employed to select the most appropriate features and the selected features are transformed using particle swarm optimization to improve the classification performance. Four different machine learning supervised algorithms are realized as classification techniques. When these four vanilla classifiers are considered, the random forest algorithm performs relatively well with balanced accuracy score of 87.5%. This score is improved to 94.4% through the usage of the proposed technique. In addition, the proposed technique enhances the prediction of the other two classifiers as well.

articleTitle: Handwritten Digit Recognition using Fine-Tuned Convolutional Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Traditional handwriting recognition algorithms were reliant heavily on existing knowledge and personalized features. It is more difficult to train a computerized optical character recognition (OCR) system using these criteria. Recent advances in the identification of handwriting research have been made possible by using deep learning techniques as their main mechanism. But when the volume of written content quickly increased and incredibly powerful computing resources became available, digit recognition accuracy had to have deteriorated, mandating more applicants’ implementation in order to yield accurate and precise results. To develop an effective approach for resolving handwriting detection challenges, this work uses the convolutional neural network (CNN) model which demonstrated the outperforming results in interpreting the structure of handwritten characters as well as phrases. This model is also capable of reducing the operational complexity and cost by implementing this model on different optimizers namely, Adam and SGD. The results have been evaluated at different numbers of epochs which identified that the proposed model outperforms with Adam optimizer by showing the highest accuracy of 98% at epoch 50. This model can be further implemented by varying the learning rate values to achieve improved accuracy and reducing the loss.

articleTitle: Compact MIMO Antenna Design using Isolation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: In this paper, the MIMO Multiple Input Multiple Output antennas are designed by placing a metamaterial structure in between the two microstrip patch antenna. While designing the MIMO antenna, there is a drawback caused due to mutual coupling, to overcome this drawback, the metamaterial structure is placed in between the antenna arrays. The antennas are spatially separated by a distance of 8mm. By placing the metamaterial structure between the antenna, isolation improvement of 7dB is obtained. The proposed design works in frequency range of 5.8GHz. Since the simulated antenna has improved gain, lower capacity loss, better isolation, and radiation efficiency, it is used in various wireless application such as automobiles, portable devices etc. The proposed antenna is well suited for MIMO antenna applications due to its advantages like low Equivalent Circuit Conductance, high gain, minimal capacity loss, and exceptionally less mutual coupling.

articleTitle: Design of High Gain 5G Millimeter wave Micro Strip Patch Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: A novel design of millimeter wave high gain micro strip patch antenna design which is much suited for automotive wireless application like vehicle to vehicle communication using RADAR operated at a frequency of 76.5 GHz is proposed herewith. The performance metric for antenna design considered are the standard metrics and depends on the type of type of substrate and dimensions. The design complexity surges with increase in frequency of operation. This paper presents the design of micro strip patch using matlab –antenna design tool box at 76.5 GHz.. The design includes three important layers namely the rectangular patch, substrate and ground. The different layers of the antenna and the substrate can be varied, analyzed and is augmented using this Matlab simulator tool. The antenna performance factors such as practical gain, radiation efficiencies, total efficiencies, bandwidth and the radiation pattern are considered for the resonant frequency 76.5 GHzs. The design implementation shows that it provides a large refection co-efficient for the operating bandwidth 1Ghzs. The simulation results show that it has a minimum return loss below – 10db, VSWR 1.2 and good radiation pattern at the design frequency. This design provides high gain and optimal bandwidth of 1 GHz with overall operating efficiency upto 97%. Thus the design can be applied for high speed wireless data transfer such as automotive, WLAN and healthcare applications.

articleTitle: BCI Controlled Robot for Drones
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: There is a significant progress in the field of brain computer Interface (BCI) technology in recent days which allows communication between human brain and external devices. This BCI technology can be used to control robotic systems such as drones using the power of thoughts. This BCI controlled robot aims to enable users to control a drone through their brain signals which provides more intuitive and efficient means of interaction. It includes many components like BCI hardware, signal processing techniques etc. The BCI hardware is responsible for acquiring the user’s brain signals and converting them into digital signals that can be processed by a computer. Electroencephalography is a technique used to measure and record the electrical activity of the brain. The electrodes are placed on the scalp to detect the electric signals produced by the neurons in the brain. The meaningful information from the acquired brain signals are extracted using signal processing algorithms. These algorithms analyze the signals and detect relevant patterns and translate them into commands for drones. The robotic drone platform includes the drone itself with communication modules. The control commands generated by the BCI system are transmitted wirelessly to the drone which enables controlling the drone. This system has numerous potential applications including searching and rescue operations and surveillance. This BCI controlled robot for drones mainly highlights the integration of BCI technology with robotic systems to enable direct control of drones using brain signals.

articleTitle: EEG Signals: Performance Analysis of the Firefly Optimization Technique for Classifying Epilepsy Risk Levels
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: The analysis of Electro Encephalography (EEG) signals is crucial in the domains of brain engineering and neuroscience, as it provides insights into the brain’s electrical activity. In this study, the risk of epilepsy was assessed using the Firefly method for feature selection; with the ShortTerm Fourier Transform (STFT) being used to extract the necessary features from the bio signals. The STFT method was found to be effective in extracting parameter components and comprehending important data related to brain function. The Firefly optimization technique was used for feature selection, and the classification was performed using the reduced dimensions. The results were compared against those of traditional machine learning methods. The proposed methodology was tested on various Bio signal datasets, with the epileptic and Bonn datasets achieving a classification accuracy of 97.5% and 95.31%, respectively

articleTitle: A Novel Transfer Learning Approach for Eye Tumour Detection using Pre-Trained CNN Models
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: According to a recent study, using retinal imaging to identify the tumour in the eye is difficult. When an image is analyzed, the affected region of the lesion impacted retinal picture is not discovered in the conventional system due to uneven illumination, low contrast, and blurring, which are symptoms of an eye disease. The proposed methodology was created to identify the eye tumour in the earlier stage with enhanced image quality and increased accuracy. The conventional system has a few drawbacks such as lower accuracy and more computational time to analyze the image. Convolutional neural networks (CNN) have recently demonstrated its result of their capacity to learn various category image denotions that aid in image classification in various sectors. These networks have a tremendous ability to extract the proper features from input images with training on millions of images, which produces accurate categorization. The deep learning-based transfer learning approach is suggested for earlier detection of eye tumours. The five pre-trained models such as AlexNet, ResNet, DensNet, VGG 19 and Inception model were used for efficient eye tumour classification. The performance analysis of the proposed approach has shown that higher accuracy of 98.63% and this model shows enhanced performance in better classification.

articleTitle: Customized Touch UI Development for E-Cockpit in Automobile
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: In recent times, the automotive industry has made significant steps towards digitization by focusing on electronic cockpits (E-Cockpits) to enhance the driving experience, comfort and safety. The incorporation of Touch-Based User Interface (UI) technologies has played a crucial role in revolutionizing Driver-Vehicle interaction [10]. The project of E-Cockpit represents a concept that consolidates various internal car systems onto one unified digital platform, enabling seamless control and access to essential infotainment, safety features, and connectivity services [14]. For the realization of the complete potential of an E-Cockpit, it is important to develop an innovative and User-Friendly touch UI as this directly influences both user experience and safety concerns.

articleTitle: Effect of Time Synchronisation in Digital Predistorter Enabled SWIPT Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: The SWIPT systems are envisioned to face substantial power amplifier nonlinearity issues as the transmission power of SWIPT systems needs to be higher than that of conventional wireless communication systems. Digital pre-distortion (DPD) is a viable solution that can be adopted in the SWIPT transmitters to linearize the power amplifiers. The efficacy of the DPD depends on the time synchronization of the feedback signal in the SWIPT transmitter unit. This paper analyses the impact of synchronization issues that affect the harvested energy and information rates associated with DPD-enabled SWIPT systems. For zero delay conditions, harvested energy of −2 dBm and Signal to Noise Ratio of 24 dBm is obtained by the digital predistorter-enabled SWIPT system.

articleTitle: A Student Efficient Interface Application for Hostel Management, Security and Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: With problems existing in student’s life such as registering a complaint to the Chief Warden follows a tedious process shuffling from one office to another. The mess feedback process exists in manual mode and not recorded properly. Improper management of faculty, organization, department details. We aim to make this digital platform mobile and easy to use with a simple user interface. The existing digital platforms require many things such as a machine and internet connection. We have incorporated the human machine interaction aspect of the application in this paper and have demonstrated how the principles of Human Computer Interaction can be applied to the same.We also have included the result of Usability testing procedure conducted on the application.

articleTitle: Classification of Wisconsin Breast Cancer Data with Extreme Learning Machine and Osprey Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: The illness reported for higher mortality in humans is cancer. On top of this, breast cancer is the most deadliest one among global women. Several clinicians and researchers are working towards earlier detection and its appropriate treatment. Thus, the requirement of robust Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD) frameworks is always in demand globally for tireless and effective diagnosis of such cancer. The paper intends to propose a CAD framework for the classification of breast tumors promptly. The research begins with the employment of initial data taken from the Wisconsin Breast Cancer database. The data preprocessing and its associated visualization are then performed. Afterward, the predominant features are selected for improving the efficacy of the framework. For this, a recently evolved Osprey Optimization Algorithm (OOA) is adopted in this work. Here, the optimization is based on the effective tactic of ospreys while hunting fishes from the oceans. Next to feature selection, the significant feature vectors are classified using Extreme Learning Machine (ELM). In addition to this, the work utilized K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN) and Mixture Kernel SVM (MiSVM) models for performance analysis. Finally, OOA features with ELM architecture provides superior accuracy of 97.66% for breast cancer classification.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of Automatic Spiral Binding and Punching Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: However, Industry 4.0 is in the stage of partial implementation and Industry 5.0 is in the primary phase of its implementation. Some day-to-day processes are still semi-automated. Practically, it takes at least 5 minutes for a bunch of paper to spiral and wrap as a booklet. When a huge crowd is in wait to do the same process in a shop, it is a loss for both the customer and the merchant. This product Automatic Spiral Binding and Punching Machine - KAKS, which does punch 25 pages and spirals more than 25 pages automatically. It has a user interface that can perform one single process at a time and also both processes one by one. This will reduce the dilated time and thus increase the profit for the merchant while reducing the time consumption for a customer. Additional features like a wireless module control system for remote access can also be accessed via the Internet through the system.

articleTitle: Object Detection and Measurement using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: This study offers a new solution for finding ring diameter in industrial areas using the Hough transform method. Accurate measurement of ring diameter during production is important to ensure product quality and performance. Our method uses a preprocessing technique to improve image quality and reduce noise, ensuring the circle is accurate with the Hough transform. The adaptability of the algorithm to different lighting conditions and data ensures performance in different industrial environments. Extensive experiments validate the proposed model, revealing the highest accuracy and computational efficiency compared to existing methods. This approach contributes to quality control over time, providing companies with powerful tools to increase productivity and product reliability.

articleTitle: An Overview on IoT Architecture Application Layer and Security Threats
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Multiple smart operations, similar as smart technologies in homes, smart metropolises, smart husbandry, and smart health and fitness centres, use a new technology known as the Internet of effects. They correspond of an multifariousness of multiple networked bias that link to multiple detectors and the internet. Among the layers that comprise an IoT armature are the perception subcaste, network subcaste, and operation subcaste. Due to their wide use, these smart biases have fairly minimum protection and are vulnerable to attacks. Comprehensive explanations of operation subcaste security issues and protocols, similar as Advance Message Queuing Protocol(AMQP) in application layer protocol, Constrained operation protocol(CoAP), and REST(Emblematic State Transport).

Author Keywords: Application layer Protocol Architecture in IoT

articleTitle: Real-Time Weapons Detection System using Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: The growing use of Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) systems in modern security applications has driven the need for automated surveillance through computer vision. The primary aim is to reduce human intervention while enhancing early threat detection and real-time security assessments. Although advanced surveillance technologies have facilitated monitoring, constant human oversight remains challenging. This has prompted a quest for models capable of identifying unlawful activities with minimal human involvement. Real-time weapon detection, despite advancements in deep learning algorithms and dedicated CCTV cameras, remains a formidable challenge, especially with varying angles and potential obstructions. Existing detection systems are often expensive and require specialized tools, necessitating a cost-effective and reliable alternative that minimizes false positives. This research focuses on creating a secure environment by utilizing real-time resources and deep-learning algorithms for identifying dangerous weapons. Without a predefined dataset for real-time detection, the researchers compiled one from diverse sources, including camera shots, internet images, movie data, YouTube CCTV recordings, and Roboflow Computer Vision Datasets. The proposed weapon detection system employs a hybrid model of Detectron2 and YOLOv7, emphasizing precision and recall in object detection, particularly in challenging conditions like lowlight environments. This research contributes to developing an effective, reliable real-time weapon detection system tailored for diverse scenarios.

articleTitle: Augmentation Applied with Transfer Learning Approach to Detect Real and Fake Faces
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Face spoofing has been prevailing in the many ways such as in face biometric attacks, morphing of photos and so on. Morphing of the photos with the other photos will cause severe problem to the particular individual and it also effect the individuality of the particular individual. There are many approaches in machine learning and deep learning has been identified to prevent the morphing of the real photos. In this proposed system, we applied the augmentation to overcome under fitting and transfer learning approaches such as Mobile net and Resnet gives more accuracy over the other deep learning approaches. The fine tuning of the hyperparameters has been evaluated with performance metrics such as Accuracy, Precision and F1 score. The proposed method yields the more accuracy of nearly 75% and 78% than other methods

articleTitle: IoT-Based Autonomous Vehicle Control
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: The rapid advancement of technology has led to the emergence of innovative solutions, and one of the most transformative areas is the development of autonomous vehicles. An IoT-based autonomous vehicle refers to a self-driving vehicle that leverages IoT devices and connectivity to interact with the surrounding environment. In this work, our focus lies on crafting a Level 3 Autonomous Vehicle that significantly reduces the need for manual control. Our endeavor hinges on the utilization of ESP32, Time of Flight (ToF) sensors, a motor driver, and a user interface (UI) for direction control. By integrating these cutting-edge technologies, we aim to elevate the precision and efficiency of autonomous vehicle operations, surpassing the capabilities of existing models. This work’s backbone revolves around the ESP32 microcontroller, a powerful platform known for its robust performance. Time of Flight (ToF) sensors come into play, further enhancing the vehicle’s ability to accurately sense its surroundings and make informed decisions. Additionally, the motor driver is seamlessly integrated to facilitate smooth and controlled movement. To ensure user-friendly interaction and control, a responsive UI has been developed. This interface empowers users to dictate the vehicle’s direction through intuitive commands and the accuracy is improved to 95%.

articleTitle: Audio to Sign Language Translation using NLP
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Communication is an essential aspect of human life, but deaf people often face challenges in communicating with hearing people due to the language barrier. According to the World Health Organization, 466 million individuals, or 5% of the global population, have severe auditory loss. In India, there are roughly 18 million people who are deaf. Sign language is the primary way of communicating information for the deaf, but it requires significant time and effort to learn. To bridge this gap, we propose an Audio to Sign Language Translation solution that converts live voice or audio recordings through text forms and shows pertinent Animated GIFs or Sign Language images. The application uses frontend Easy Gui, PyAudio for microphone input, Google Speech API, and Sphinx for speech recognition, NLP for text preprocessing, and a dictionary-based machine translation approach for sign language generation. The algorithm follows a logical sequence of steps and provides an accurate and reliable solution to facilitate communication between deaf and hearing people. The purpose of this application is to give deaf individuals access to information and services in Indian sign language and to create a scalable project that can record the whole ISL vocabulary using both manual and non-manual signs. Overall, by enabling deaf people to communicate, the Audio to Sign Language Translation has the ability to significantly improve their quality of life to communicate easily and effectively with others.

articleTitle: Hybridization Methodology for Predicting ORE from Mines to End User using Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Iron ore is the most important iron ore in India and it is often lost on the way from the mine to its final destination. Manual sorting of many types of iron ore is difficult and time consuming. We deploy the most advanced RFID technology, along with weighbridges and GPS tracking systems, to solve this problem. Instead of using F-CNN, Iron ore grades were classified using a preliminary object recognition algorithm (YOLO V5). One crucial technical job in mining and excavation is locating mineral reserves. Conventional methods, however, are laborious and time-consuming. The concept makes use of machine learning capabilities to provide proactive, data-driven mine-to-end-user logistics, which minimizes environmental impact, lowers costs, and increases efficiency. Thus, datasets pertaining to mineral reserves were classified more accurately through the application of data augmentation and transfer learning. Comparative trials showed that using transfer learning may effectively counteract the improvement of categorization performance, up to and including 94%. This is a new concept for mining problems that can be solved by the above mentioned method.

articleTitle: Breast Tumor Classification using Transfer Learning with Adaptive Crow Search Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Breast cancer is a prevalent form of cancer among women, with around 2,87,850 newer cases acknowledged in 2022. In addition, a substantial amount of female deaths, with 43,250 were accounted to this cancer type. Early detection plays a crucial role in reducing the higher mortality rate associated with breast cancer. However, precisely diagnosing this cancer type from mammography images involves the expertise of trained clinicians. For improving the diagnostic process, researchers have explored the potential of artificial intelligence techniques. The paper utilizes an Adaptive Crow-Search Optimization (AdCSO) algorithm to boost breast cancer diagnosis. The adaptability and premature convergence problems of conventional crow-search optimization algorithm is made improved using the AdCSO algorithm. The proposed framework consists of three main stages: data augmentation, feature extraction using EfficientNetV2 based on transfer learning, and optimized classification using a convolutional neural network (CNN). The mammograms from the INbreast dataset are employed for work evaluation. By leveraging transfer learning and an optimized CNN for classification, the proposed EfficientNetV2 with AdCSO-CNN provides a maximum classification performance of 97.05% accuracy as compared with other approaches. The proposed method is tested against the above problem with two output classes: benign and malignant.

articleTitle: Automated Theertham Dispenser (ATD): A safety Method for Providing Holy Water to the Devotees in the Indian Temples
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has taught us that handing out anything contactless is the most secure way to avoid any pathogen-contaminated surface. Though one may not have seen a priest distributing holy water for devotees to be anything unsanitary, the pandemic has made us retrospect those past views. While giving holy water to devotees, there is a chance that pathogens may spread from the priest to hundreds of devotees who come to the temple. Since health concern is one such thing that can never be ignored, we have developed a gadget to ensure that the ‘theertham’ (holy water) is delivered to each devotee’s hand without any contact with faster delivery, assured 99% safety and 98% accuracy.

articleTitle: Deep-Sea Survival Assistance and Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Deep-sea diving is an adventurous and challenging activity that demands meticulous attention to safety and reliance on a diverse array of systems and equipment to ensure the well- being of divers. These systems are indispensable for managing the unique physiological hurdles posed by deep-water environments, navigating through often challenging underwater landscapes, and responding effectively to unexpected emergencies. A breakdown or malfunction of any of these vital tools and apparatuses could potentially lead to grave risks for divers. This device, engineered for individuals who may find themselves in distress or danger while submerged in water, integrates seamlessly with a Raspberry Pi 3B+ as its controller. This innovative system operates through continuous monitoring of the individual's pulse and brain waves while they are in the water. In the event that the system detects a sudden and alarming drop in the person's pulse rate, it immediately activates an airbag that surrounds and envelops the person. This airbag is inflated with gas, which can either be drawn from the surrounding atmosphere or sourced from an oxygen cylinder if the diver happens to have one, with the help of the IoT.

Author Keywords: inflates with gas, malfunction, wi-fi protocol, IoT

articleTitle: Enhanced AI Voice Assistance using Machine Learning and NLP
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: The project’s primary intent is to emphasize an Enhanced AI Voice Assistant that wields machine learning (ML) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) to carry through the tasks using voice commands. With a minimal, user-friendly graphical interface in the idea, the automated voice-controlled assistant has been designed to execute a comprehensive set of voice commands. This provides users with an openly and effective way to cop up with their computers. The achievement of this voice assistant is in alignment with the more general goal of enhancing user interface performance with computers. It promises to make common computer tasks simpler and more accessible to a larger number of users by creating a more natural and seamless interaction model. The purpose of the enhanced AI voice assistant is to serve as an intelligent assistant that enables users to carry out activities easily with voice commands by combining speech recognition, natural language processing, and machine learning. Enhanced productivity, user-friendly design, availability, and an overall improved computing experience are some of the implicit advantages it offers.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Deep Learning Approach for Colon Cancer Prediction using Histopathological Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Colon cancer, a significant contributor to both mortality and disability, results from a complex interplay of genetic and metabolic factors. The timely detection of this condition relies on histological examination, particularly the analysis of glandular structures within tissue regions. This leads to the development of different screening tests for investigating polyps images and colorectal cancer. In this study, we present a comprehensive approach driven by deep learning to identify colon cancer from histopathological images. In this work, the deep learning techniques, including MobileNet and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) were employed, to train a dataset for the prediction of colon cancer. Furthermore, the deep learning models are assessed using standard performance metrics such as Accuracy, F1 score, MCC, Error rate, and Kappa. The results of the experiment show that the MobileNet model exhibited an outstanding accuracy of 98% whereas, the CNN model achieved an accuracy of 76% when differentiating between adenocarcinoma and benign tissues. The developed model shows promise in providing pathologists with a powerful tool for accurate and timely diagnoses.

articleTitle: Implementation of Partial RNS-Assisted Mutual Authentication Protocol for RFID-Enabled IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Hardware cryptography is a focused area to implement the recent wireless technologies such as healthcare applications. The rapid advancement of technology has led to various security breaches in the applications, and the combination of RFID and IoT technology provides the solution in recent days. An efficient encoder for mutual authentication protocol suitable for lightweight RFID-enabled IoT applications is developed in this work. Partial Residue Number System (RNS) without reverse converter and Dual Modular Multiplier Function (DMMF) is used to design an encoder that provides more security to the protocol. The encoder architecture is described using Verilog HDL, and its performance is evaluated in ASIC platform. From the qualitative analysis, the proposed Partial RNS-assisted Mutual Authentication Protocol provides appreciable security and performance balance than the state-of-the-art MAP, which can be utilized for RFID-Enabled IoT Devices.

articleTitle: Agronomic Monitoring Module
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: IoT technology has sparked a revolution across various sectors of everyday life, including agriculture, industries, etc by imbuing everyday objects with intelligence. In agriculture, innovative technologies have been developed to address challenges related to crop production systems, encompassing chemical, physical, biological, and socioeconomic constraints. This paper focuses on the sensor technologies that prove invaluable to farmers to increase production. These sensors serve to monitor diverse parameters such as temperature, humidity, rainfall, nutrient levels, and so on. The sensors outlined in the paper encompass an array of functions, including providing insights into soil and air temperature, rainfall patterns, leaf moisture, chlorophyll content, wind direction, solar radiation, relative humidity, and atmospheric pressure and more. The proposed product has been tested in live agricultural fields, demonstrating an exceptional data feed accuracy of over 98%. The central premise of this paper lies in utilizing sensors to detect and relay information about pH levels, temperature, nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium, rain detection crucial factors in effective crop management.

Author Keywords: Ph of soil sensor (Nitrogen Phosphorus and Potassium) sensor

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Vivaldi Antenna by an Iterative Method
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: A Vivaldi antenna is designed with iterative method and analysed the simulated result characteristics. The study tests the simulation's accuracy and verifies the antenna's compatibility for wireless systems using the advanced simulation software tool, CADFeko. Important metrics include radiation pattern, reflection co-efficient and voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR). The results demonstrate strong acceptance and underline the enhanced value of the Vivaldi antenna in various forthcoming wireless communication applications.

articleTitle: Early Detection and Prognosis of Brain Tumor from Micro Array Gene Data using Machine Learning Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Brain tumour is one of the most lethal illnesses affecting the brain. It typically begins as little benign cells that form on the interior of brain cells and progresses to tumour. Brain tumours are caused by the spread of somatic mutations that change gene expression. The DNA microarray method offers a standardized format for evaluating the levels of gene expression in thousands of different genes. Microarray technology's patterns of gene expression can be utilized to distinguish between cancers from various anatomical regions. A two level classification strategy is suggested because processing the microarray data requires processing very large amounts of data due to the problem of dimensionality. The genes or characteristics are dimensionally condensed in the first level using Particle Swarm Optimization and Cuckoo Search Algorithm technique. Five classifiers namely GMM, KNN, BLDC, FDC and SVM (RBF) are used to detect brain tumor. Classifiers performance are validated from the parameters such as F1 Score, ER and MCC. When comparing all classifiers, SVM (RBF) settled at the accuracy (92%). SVM (RBF) appears to be the most effective classifier for distinguishing brain tumor cells from normal cells based on gene expression patterns.

articleTitle: Dent and Scratch Detection using Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: This paper gives insights on identification and feature extraction of vehicle damage caused by numerous obstacles and other impending cars. In the past, automotive specialists mostly used physical examinations to find automobile defects and scratches. This procedure entailed visually inspecting the whole vehicle’s surface under lighting conditions to find flaws. These systems can analyse enormous volumes of data quickly and find flaws with higher precision and consistency by utilising the power of computer vision. We used Yolov8 architecture to identify the dents and scratches of vehicles and achieved an mean average precision of 0.579 with threshold value of 0.5.

articleTitle: Classification and Detection of Blood Subtype Cells Images using Hybrid Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Today, people’s personal health is mainly monitored through blood parameters. The increase in white blood cells will lead to more complicated, having four classes in white blood cells are Eosinophil, Lymphocyte, Monocyte and Neutrophil. Each subtype having some range, if it exceeds that range, we get infected. The proposed hybrid CNN model that evaluates the white blood cell in the image collected through different data sources. It identifies the White Blood Cells present in the blood cell image and highlight the cell and also clarifies the presence of Eosinophil, Lymphocyte, Monocyte and Neutrophil. The analysis is made on precision, recall, f1-score, accuracy to evaluate the performance of the model. Our proposed model proves to be ahead than the other model proposed in the previous work.

Author Keywords: Convolutional Neural Network and Hybrid model

articleTitle: Secure Supply Chain Management using RFID-IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Supply chain management is very much important in current implementation of Industry 4.0 applications. The production from the industries is transported to the customers through various intermediate systems. The monitoring and tracking of any resources throughout its end destination is much difficult to maintain the data especially for the raw commodities like ore, agricultural, metals where the loads are of uncountable but can be measurable through weights. RFID is a promising technology in tracking and the data is communicated to the cloud. The load sensors can be utilized along with microcontroller to send the real time data of the weight of the load carried during the transport. The RFID enables the tracking in support with GPS enabled technology. Security is possible via Blockchain that helps in the complete automatic tracking and monitoring the supply chain management. In this paper, a prototypic implementation of RFID-IoT in collecting data and the transactions are deployed by smart contracts in blockchain. The results show the hardware prototype that efficiently helps in monitoring of the load, transport and tracking of the intermediate stations through RFID-IoT and the security is highly enhanced by blockchain technique.

articleTitle: Analysis of Machine Learning Classifiers for the Detection of Lung Cancer from Micro Array Gene Data
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Microarray gene data is a good resource for studying gene expression patterns of various biological processes and diseases. The paper adopts a classification method of high-dimensional microarray gene data for lung cancer by utilizing dimensionality reduction and feature selection techniques. The dimensionality reduction is done by Short Time Fourier Transform (STFT) and utilizes Scalogram as the feature selection technique. The classifiers, namely Non-Linear Regression (NLR), Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), Softmax Discriminant Classifier (SDC), SVM (polynomial) and SVM (RBF) are employed for classification. The classifiers’ performances are analyzed and compared. The SVM (RBF) classifier with the Short-Time Fourier Transform Dimensionality Reduction method and Scalogram 1024 feature selection achieved the highest accuracy of 96.13 % compared to other classifiers.

Author Keywords: Lung cancer classification Micro array gene data

articleTitle: SPRUCE: A Wearable Self-Analysis System for Real-Time Sports Performance Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: The convergence of talent and determination often faces an impediment in the form of financial constraints, preventing individuals from accessing proper coaching and refining their skills. To address this issue, “SPRUCE”, is introduced which is an innovative wearable device tailored for self-analysis and performance monitoring in sports. The device is ingeniously integrated into sports equipment, such as racquets, and interfaces with a mobile application, obviating the need for a dedicated coach.SPRUCE capitalizes on advancements in wearable technology to empower athletes by offering real-time self-assessment. The device employs sensors strategically positioned on racquets to capture orientation and acceleration data. This information is then processed by an Arduino board, continuously seeking sensor output. The resultant data aids in the computation of linear and angular racquet motion during play, including the speed and impact angle of ball strikes. Subsequently, these calculated parameters are seamlessly transmitted to a mobile app via Bluetooth connectivity.

articleTitle: Web 3.0: A Decentralized Future Empowered by Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 Third International Conference on Smart Technologies, Communication and Robotics (STCR)
abstract: Web 3.0, marks the third stage in the evolution of the World Wide Web. Its primary aim is to establish a decentralized and all-encompassing system built upon blockchain technology and advancements in the Semantic Web. In this upcoming version of the internet, users will have the capability to maintain ownership of their data, safeguarding their privacy.
